title: Austin Environmental Charter Vote
summary:
*   Austin officials held a special meeting to discuss proposed Environmental Charter Amendments.
*   A resolution was officially adopted opposing these Environmental Charter Amendments.
*   The decision passed with a 4-2 vote, indicating some internal disagreement on the policy.
transcript:
